Frequently asked questions.

Have more questions or need help?

Contact support

How does inabit work?

Inabit provides a secure, self-custodial wallet infrastructure that lets businesses create wallets, move funds, automate policies, and run on/off-ramp flows across multiple blockchains and banking rails - all through one unified platform.

What can I build with inabit?

You can build crypto payments, treasury automation, on/off-ramping, PSP integrations, sweeping workflows, liquidity routing, multi-user governance, and more, without managing blockchain complexity yourself.

Do I need blockchain expertise to use inabit?

No. Inabit abstracts away the blockchain layer. Your team interacts with simple APIs while the platform handles wallets, transactions, signing, compliance, and network operations behind the scenes.

Which blockchains does inabit support?

Inabit supports multiple chains such as Ethereum, Tron, Bitcoin, BNB Chain, and more with ongoing expansions. Each chain includes full support for wallet creation, transfers, policies, and sweeping.

Is the system self-custodial?

Yes. Inabit uses a self-custodial architecture where only your organization controls the keys. We don’t hold customer funds, private keys, or signing permissions.
